# WF21 · Thu ngân · có đơn nháp

Group **WF · Thu ngân & lên đơn** · state · Next.js: **built (U5)** (`/cashier`) · account `owner-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/order-ui.js#history`
- Cashier is `operations-ui.js › cashier()`; the quick-order dialog and the order history are `order-ui.js`; the A5 review page is `order-review/index.html` + `order-review.js`; data and rules are `order-data.js`.
- `order-ui.js › history()` (section "Đơn thuốc & phiếu tư vấn", subtitle "Nháp → bác sĩ duyệt → in và hiển thị trên app"): one row per order, "<patient> <date> · <n> sản phẩm · Bản nháp" with "Xem / in" (`orderPreview`) and "Sửa nháp" (`orderEdit`).
- `operations-ui.js › cashier()`: the new invoice is the first table row ("Đơn sản phẩm · 1 dòng", the order code with "In tách đơn", 5.500 ₫, 0 ₫, 5.500 ₫, "Thu tiền"); the stats read Tổng hóa đơn 49 and Còn phải thu 11.255.500 ₫ (11.250.000 + 5.500).
- Inventory note: Order history row with "Xem / in" and "Sửa nháp", and the new invoice row "Đơn sản phẩm" in the invoice table (WF1 shows the empty history "Chưa có đơn từ catalog.").
- Page key `cashier` is allowed for roles: owner, accountant (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `owner-tam`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- Controls removed for roles without the capability: `ops=pay` needs `billing` (roles owner/accountant); `ops=quick-order` needs `billing` (roles owner/accountant).
- How to reach it in the old web: {"block":"http://127.0.0.1:4174/**"} → {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"cashier\"]"} → {"click":"[data-ops=\"quick-order\"]"} → {"wait":"#catalog-order-form"} → {"click":"[data-quick-add=\"H002\"]"} → {"fill":["#usage-0","Bôi lớp mỏng, sáng và tối, 14 ngày"]} → {"clickPopup":"#quick-save"} → {"wait":".order-sheet"} → {"main":true} → {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}&screen=cashier"} → {"wait":".order-history-row"}; it must show "Bản nháp".

## Required text (keep verbatim)
- (no notice or empty state on this screen)

## Business rules
- "AI chỉ là bản nháp" principle for orders: a draft needs the responsible doctor's approval before it is printed or shown in the patient app ("Đơn nháp cần bác sĩ duyệt trước khi in.").
- "Nháp → bác sĩ duyệt → in và hiển thị trên app"

## Differences from the app design
- App I10 lists invoices as cards with Thu tiền and no order history, order code or "In tách đơn" link; the order list belongs to the app order screens (F4–F7).

## Gotchas
- Invoice and order codes are random UUIDs (`HD-<uuid>`, `OD-<uuid>`): the snapshot masks them. The data lives in the browser storage of the demo, so the figures are the same on every run.
- Created with the finance API blocked so no invoice reaches the shared finance data.
- Canvas: invoice and order codes (HD-7F3A9C, OD-B21E40) are synthetic; the old web shows random UUIDs. The top bar reads "Tài chính chờ kết nối · thử lại" because the finance API is blocked in the reach.
